subject: general
question: A species that cannot be found after a prolonged search in its area of habitation is said to be ________ species.
solution:
The correct answer is __**extinct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Extinct Species**

 
 
• A species that** cannot **be found after a prolonged search in its area of habitation is said to be **extinct species**.
 
• A species** loses all of its genetic heritage **when it goes extinct.
 
• In order to adapt to alterations in the environment or genetic inheritance,** species evolve into new species**.
 
• According to estimates, there are currently between **10 and 14 million species, of which more than 1.2 million have been researched and more than 86% have yet to be discovered**.
 
• **Causes of Extinction**
 
 
• Climate change
 
• Loss of habitat
 
• Diseases
 
• Lack of genetic diversity
 
 
 
• Some common examples of extinct species are** Passenger Pigeon, Dodo, Tasmanian Tiger, Baiji White Dolphin, Pyrenean Ibex**, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rare Species**

 
 
• A species is considered rare if its **population is so limited that it could become vulnerable or endangered**.
 
• Examples:** the wild Asiatic buffalo the Himalayan brown bear, the desert fox, the hornbill**, etc.
 
 
 
• **Endangered Species**
 
 
• Species in **risk of going extinct **are referred to as endangered species.
 
• Examples:** Indian wild ass, Indian rhino, lion-tailed macaque, black buck, crocodile, and sangai** (brow anter deer in Manipur).
 
 
 
• **Vulnerable Species **
 
 
• The term "vulnerable species" refers to those** species whose populations have dropped to the point where they are likely to become endangered**.
 
• Examples: **Gangetic dolphin, blue sheep, Asiatic elephant**, etc.
